paragraphs: Disaster Tech builds PRATUS, a platform for AI-driven emergency management aimed at organizations and communities. The product provides AI-powered real-time data insights. The company frames the work as protecting lives and property, from extreme weather to critical infrastructure failures.

PRATUS integrates live weather data, critical infrastructure impact models and analytics for near-instant situational awareness. One view brings together objectives, assets and operational tasks. Its AI lets users generate SITREPs, access real-time updates and produce after-action reports in seconds. The platform also supports training and exercises, from tabletop drills to full-scale deployments. It is available for purchase through the Microsoft Teams App Store.

The company describes itself as a certified Veteran-Owned Business committed to advancing public safety and resilience. It is headquartered in Alexandria, VA. Contract vehicles are offered so government, defense, energy and public safety organizations can reach the platform. Sean Griffin is CEO and co-founder, and previously served as Director for Incident Management Integration Policy on the U.S. National Security Council at the White House.

quote.text: PRATUS AI is a generative AI tool built by and for emergency management professionals
